title: Node contracts of a task contract
description: What each step of building an inference engine must take, produce and pass. A planner orders these nodes into a task graph; the factory works each node with capsules and tools; a verifier checks every declared output; the last node hands the engine to the lab manager. Field names follow the M1 Node Execution Contract (design-package reference/field-catalog.md) where the meaning is the same. Carried in a format-2 contract under extensions["factory.node-contracts"].

capability.description: A capsule capability: <capsule id>.<capability>, for example engine.build_expert_weight_cache.verify.

kind.description: Task graph node kind. deliver hands the engine to the lab manager.

objective.description: One plain sentence: what this node does for the task. Copied to the task graph node title.

requirement_ids.description: Contract arms, checks and metrics (by id) this node serves.

predecessors.description: Nodes that must be done before this one starts. Includes every node an input comes from.

from.description: <node>.<output> of a predecessor, contract:<input name>, or task:source|objective|target.

kind.description: diff: source changes in the owned checkout. source_bundle: a stored lab source bundle. image: an engine image from a recorded build. lab_request: a request sent through the lab manager. evidence: factory records (observations, artifacts).

criteria.description: Plain-language acceptance criteria the verifier and the reviewer judge the output against.

effects.description: Most effects work in this node may use; intersected with the task's allowed_effects.

helpful_ccs.description: Capsules whose methods help with this node. Advice to the worker and the reviewer, not a requirement.

eligible_ccs.description: Preliminary contracts: the capsules the scheduler may bind. Absent: any capsule in the catalog.

bound_ccs.description: Final contracts: the capsules the scheduler bound to this node at run time.

verifiers.description: One per output to check (the M1 verifier subnode per output).

review.description: true: an independent reviewer runs and its blocker findings or fail verdict fail the check. advisory: the reviewer runs and its verdict and findings are recorded and shown, but only the capsule verifier and the host checks decide pass or fail. false: no review.

inputs.description: Verifier inputs the contract fixes (targets, tolerances, expected ranges); merged over the agent verifier_inputs, a different agent value is refused.

hands_to.description: The node that uses this node's outputs next, or lab_manager for the delivery node.

stage.description: preliminary: written by the planner, finalized by the scheduler just before the node runs (node_finalize.py). final, or absent: ready to run as written.

slots.description: Preliminary contracts: what the scheduler fills at run time.

at.description: Where the value goes in the final contract.

within.description: Allowed [low, high] for a number, or the outer limit of a range.

from.description: Where the scheduler gets the value: a predecessor output, a measurement, the machine state.

bounds.description: Preliminary contracts: pinned verifier inputs the scheduler may tighten, keyed verifiers.<output>.inputs.<key>. inside: a range may only narrow; lower/higher: the value may only go down/up. Inputs not listed stay equal.
